interpretation.source_and_intake: Recorded data/read/row-group and copied/transferred buffer counters; intake bytes exclude decoder internals and later operators.
interpretation.native_pushdown: Source-inferred from exact snapshot: comparison and AND cases admit native scan predicates; scan delivered rows are after that provider filter.
interpretation.residual: Source-inferred: OR-of-NOT and NOT-of-AND retain the shared expression filter; their scan-delivered rows remain one million before filtering.
interpretation.masks: Source-inferred: admitted pure I64 Boolean recipe evaluates word masks; LocalSelection materializes bounded U16 indices and slices contiguous selections or takes others. No per-case mask bytes or elapsed times were recorded.
interpretation.ordering: Recorded prefix rows are the post-filter validation population, not input rows avoided. Copy bytes and peak buffers cover ordering ownership, not all physical traffic. C8 changes numeric comparison/location binding without changing these source/copy counts.
interpretation.distinct: COUNT DISTINCT reads the complete nullable key domain and uses exact native membership with null exclusion; no sort or bounded-ordering payload copy is recorded.
interpretation.limitation: Historical IPC/API-clock comparator observations remain diagnosis only. No matched-format speed ranking, phase timing decomposition, causal per-stage savings or total copied-byte claim.
